title: A code/<id> branch is named after the item whose code it carries
goal: kbgit.py sync names the code/<id> branch after the KB-Work id of the first code-lane commit in the range, not the first KB-Work id of any commit, so a content claim of another item riding along does not name the merge request (code/TK-5mrfocpz carried TK-opkxumeu's code in SP-v5xagbyv)
